You wan release object wey get mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ from rest for di rail so e go make one full turn for di loop. Take $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Which one correctly match, in order, di minimum starting height $h_{min}$ (from di bottom) so e go pass di top of di loop without leaving di rail, and di normal force $15\,\mathrm{m}$ wey di rail dey exert on di object for di top if di starting height na $N$?
physics-killer-02.thinking.0: Work and conversion between mechanical energies (Inquiry)
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: One vertical circular loop wey get radius $0$ connect to di bottom (height $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$) of rail wey no get friction. You wan release object wey get mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ from rest for di rail so e go make one full turn for di loop. Take $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Which one correctly match, in order, di minimum starting height $h_{min}$ (from di bottom) so e go pass di top of di loop without leaving di rail, and di normal force $15\,\mathrm{m}$ wey di rail dey exert on di object for di top if di starting height na $N$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Minimum condition $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. For conservation of energy $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$ from $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. For $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. For $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. If you use only di height $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ you forget kinetic energy (wrong answer ①), $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ ignore gravity (wrong answer ②), $90\,\mathrm{N}$ na sign error wey add gravity (wrong answer ③).

physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
